meta.description: Infers ligand-receptor cell-cell communication from scRNA-seq with a consensus-first workflow (LIANA), plus CellPhoneDB specificity tests, CellChat pathway probabilities, and NicheNet downstream ligand-activity. Use when ranking ligand-receptor interactions between cell types, comparing communication across conditions, asking which ligand drives a receiver response, or deciding which CCC method and resource to trust.

scientific_integrity.detail: All cited papers (Vento-Tormo 2018, Efremova 2020, Jin 2021, Browaeys 2020, Dimitrov 2022/2024, Hou 2020, Cang 2023, Palla 2022, Luo 2023, Young 2020, van den Brink 2017) are real, correctly attributed. No fabricated statistics anywhere in the Skill or in the audit's own real-data outputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: Purely basic-research scRNA-seq analysis; no individual-patient diagnostic or prescriptive claims anywhere in the Skill, so no clinical disclaimer is required.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill actively prevents methodological fallacies: explicit Governing Principle against treating co-expression as proof of signaling, explicit warning against comparing raw interaction counts across conditions (abundance/depth confound), explicit warning against CellPhoneDB-on-mouse-data ortholog errors.

code_usability.detail: LIANA code block ran unmodified on real PBMC data (Input 1). CellPhoneDB code block ran successfully on real PBMC data after adding the standard `if __name__=='__main__':` Windows multiprocessing guard that SKILL.md's example omits (Input 2) -- a fixable portability gap, not a logic bug or missing dependency, so it does not meet M4's FAIL bar; recorded as a P1 instead. CellChat/NicheNet (R, GitHub-only packages) could not be executed in this Windows audit environment (TOOLS.md: RcppPlanc-chain compile failure, explicitly out of core scope) but were verified by static inspection against the real, documented package APIs with no fabricated functions found.

functional_suitability.note: Covers LIANA consensus, CellPhoneDB specificity, CellChat pathway, NicheNet mechanism, and spatial-aware branching well, but two factual inaccuracies were empirically found: the single-group 'autocrine self-edges' claim does not match LIANA's real behavior (raises ValueError instead), and the CellPhoneDB code block does not run as-is on Windows.

reliability.note: Common Errors table (8 rows) gives clear symptom/cause/fix guidance; Confounds table proactively warns before running. No structured SKILL_* error codes for the agent-first context, and no proactive check for the Windows multiprocessing guard issue found in Input 2.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 221 lines, concise; all four methods' full code blocks are loaded eagerly rather than layered into references/, but the file stays well within a manageable budget.

agent_usability.note: Method Decision Table gives immediate, unambiguous routing; terminology (magnitude/specificity rank, resource, groupby) is fully consistent; Common Errors + Confounds tables are strong proactive error prevention.

human_usability.note: Description and usage-guide.md Example Prompts match natural researcher phrasing well.

security.note: No credentials, no raw-string execution, no injection vectors; all inputs are file paths and biological parameters.

maintainability.note: Method sections are cleanly separated and independently modifiable, but only 2 of 4 documented methods (LIANA, CellChat) have a matching examples/ script; CellPhoneDB and NicheNet code exists only inline in SKILL.md.

agent_specific.note: Trigger description is precise and composability (8-skill Related Skills cross-links) is excellent. Idempotency is mixed: LIANA is deterministic by the tool's own seed=1337 default (empirically confirmed identical across 2 runs), but CellPhoneDB's documented call never sets debug_seed and was empirically shown non-deterministic on marginal p-values across repeated runs.

inputs.label: LIANA rank_aggregate consensus on real annotated PBMC 1k v3 data
inputs.note: SKILL.md's Consensus Inference code ran unmodified (only file path/groupby changed) on real 10x PBMC data annotated with CellTypist Immune_All_Low + Leiden. 31,812 pairs scored, 1,122 robust (both ranks <0.05); top hits are real immune biology (B2M-KLRD1 NK-inhibitory axis, S100A8/9-ITGB2/CD68/CD36 monocyte-DAMP signaling, APP-CD74 DC-B cell), not noise. Reran twice: identical magnitude_rank/specificity_rank and identical robust set both times.

assertions.text: Code from SKILL.md's Consensus Inference block runs unmodified (aside from file path) on real annotated PBMC data
assertions.note: Ran with zero code changes beyond the input file path.

assertions.text: Output reports both magnitude_rank and specificity_rank as documented, not a single combined rank
assertions.note: adata.uns['liana_res'] contains both columns exactly as SKILL.md states.

assertions.text: Top-ranked robust interactions correspond to known immune biology, not random noise
assertions.note: B2M-KLRD1 (NK inhibitory checkpoint), S100A8/9-ITGB2/CD68/CD36 (monocyte DAMP-to-scavenger/integrin signaling), APP-CD74 (DC-B cell) dominate the top of the ranked list.

assertions.text: Results are reproducible across repeated runs with the documented call
assertions.note: Two independent runs produced identical magnitude_rank/specificity_rank values (max abs diff 0.0) and an identical 1,122-pair robust set (liana's internal seed=1337 default).

inputs.label: CellPhoneDB v5 statistical (permutation) specificity test on the same real PBMC data
inputs.note: Executed successfully and found real immune biology (HLA-E/F-VSIR/LILRB1/2 checkpoint pairs, CCL3/CCL5-CCR1, ICAM2/3-integrin aLb2, ANXA1-FPR1/2), but only after two real defects were found and worked around: (1) the documented top-level script crashes on Windows with a multiprocessing RuntimeError under score_interactions=True unless wrapped in `if __name__=='__main__':`; (2) reran the (fixed) script twice with identical inputs and the default (unset) debug_seed=-1 and found 252/120,375 p<0.05 significance flags flipped between runs.

assertions.text: SKILL.md's documented CellPhoneDB code block runs out-of-the-box as a standalone script on Windows without modification
assertions.note: Crashes with RuntimeError ('An attempt has been made to start a new process before the current process has finished its bootstrapping phase') from score_interactions=True's internal multiprocessing.Pool call; fixed by adding an `if __name__=='__main__':` guard, which SKILL.md's example does not have.

assertions.text: Once correctly entry-point-guarded, the code executes and returns p-values/means matching the documented output structure
assertions.note: results['pvalues'] and results['means'] returned as documented, shape (535, 238).

assertions.text: Significant interactions include known immune ligand-receptor biology, not spurious hits
assertions.note: HLA-E/HLA-F-VSIR/LILRB1/LILRB2 (inhibitory checkpoints), CCL3/CCL5-CCR1, ICAM2/3-integrin aLb2 (LFA-1 adhesion), ANXA1-FPR1/2 all significant (p=0.0) for monocyte->NK, matching textbook immune biology.

assertions.text: Permutation p-values are reproducible across repeated runs with identical inputs, as the documented call is written (no debug_seed set)
assertions.note: Two runs with identical inputs and the default debug_seed=-1 disagreed on 252 of 120,375 (p<0.05) significance flags (max single p-value swing 0.29); the deep/robust hits (p=0.0) were stable, only marginal calls near the cutoff flipped.

assertions.text: The Skill documents CellPhoneDB's human-only-database limitation elsewhere so a user hitting near-empty mouse results has an explanation
assertions.note: Common Errors table row: 'Mouse CellPhoneDB run returns almost nothing | CellPhoneDB DB is human-only'.

inputs.label: CCC requested with only one cell-type group present
inputs.note: SKILL.md states a single groupby category 'yields only autocrine self-edges, not intercellular signaling.' Empirically, li.mt.rank_aggregate on a constant single-value groupby column instead raises a clear ValueError ('Cannot compute log2FC for group... every cell belongs to it') rather than returning autocrine edges. Practical guidance (need >=2 groups) is correct; the described mechanism is not.

assertions.text: Skill correctly identifies that CCC requires >=2 cell types in groupby
assertions.note: Practical conclusion is correct even though the described mechanism is not.

assertions.text: The failure mode described in SKILL.md ('yields only autocrine self-edges') matches what LIANA actually does with a single-group column
assertions.note: LIANA raises a ValueError instead of silently returning autocrine-only edges.

assertions.text: The actual error is a clear, actionable exception rather than a crash or silent bad output
assertions.note: ValueError message names the exact cause (no comparison group for log2FC).

key_strengths: Governing Principle and Method Decision Table give an unusually rigorous, correct methodological framing (distinct estimands across LIANA/CellPhoneDB/CellChat/NATMI, consensus-first default, resource-sensitivity check) rarely seen at this depth in a single Skill.
LIANA consensus workflow ran unmodified on real 10x PBMC data and surfaced genuine, textbook immune biology (B2M-KLRD1 NK-checkpoint, S100A8/9-monocyte-DAMP signaling) with zero code changes.
CellPhoneDB specificity test, once entry-point-guarded, likewise surfaced real biology (HLA-E/F-VSIR/LILRB checkpoints, CCL3/5-CCR1, ICAM2/3-LFA1) on the same real data.
Common Errors and Confounds tables proactively cover 8+ real failure modes (ambient RNA, abundance/depth confounds, dissociation stress, mouse-vs-human DB, resource sensitivity) before they occur.

Excellent composability: 8-skill Related Skills cross-links correctly identify every real upstream/downstream dependency (annotation, clustering, doublet detection, preprocessing, DE for NicheNet's gene set).

recommendations.title: CellPhoneDB code block is not Windows-safe as documented
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's 'Specificity Test (CellPhoneDB v5)' code block (lines ~106-119) is written as flat top-level script code. Run exactly as given on Windows with score_interactions=True, it crashes with a multiprocessing RuntimeError ('An attempt has been made to start a new process before the current process has finished its bootstrapping phase') because cellphonedb's score_interactions path calls multiprocessing.Pool internally.
recommendations.root_cause: The example omits the standard `if __name__ == '__main__':` guard that Windows multiprocessing.Pool requires; the code was presumably only tested on Linux/macOS (fork-based), where this guard is not needed.
recommendations.fix: Wrap the code block's body in `def main(): ...` / `if __name__ == '__main__': main()`, or add a one-line note before the block: 'On Windows, wrap this in `if __name__ == "__main__":` -- score_interactions=True uses multiprocessing.Pool.'

recommendations.title: CellPhoneDB permutation results are non-deterministic by default
recommendations.problem: The documented cpdb_statistical_analysis_method.call(...) example never sets debug_seed, which defaults to -1 (unseeded). Two identical runs on the same real PBMC data produced different p-values for 252 of 120,375 (cell-pair, interaction) combinations at the p<0.05 threshold.
recommendations.root_cause: debug_seed is an explicit parameter of the real cellphonedb API (confirmed via inspect.signature) that the Skill's example simply never sets, unlike LIANA's rank_aggregate, which defaults to a fixed seed=1337 and was empirically confirmed deterministic across repeated runs.
recommendations.fix: Add `debug_seed=<int>` (e.g. 42) to the documented cpdb_statistical_analysis_method.call(...) example and add a row to the Threshold and Permutation Rationale table noting that debug_seed must be set for reproducible reporting, mirroring the existing n_perms/iterations row.

recommendations.title: Cross-condition comparison is promised but has no runnable code pattern
recommendations.problem: The frontmatter description explicitly promises 'comparing communication across conditions', and the Governing Principle and Common Errors table both name the correct approach (Tensor-cell2cell decomposition, or CellChat differential comparison) -- but neither gets a code block, unlike the other four capabilities (LIANA, CellPhoneDB, CellChat pathway, NicheNet), each of which has a full runnable example.
recommendations.root_cause: The condition-comparison capability was documented at the conceptual/warning level (what not to do) but never built out to the same code-example depth as the rest of the Skill.
recommendations.fix: Add a 'Condition Comparison' section with a runnable code block -- e.g. LIANA rank_aggregate run per-condition subset feeding into Tensor-cell2cell, or CellChat's mergeCellChat()/netVisual_diffInteraction() two-object workflow -- matching the depth of the existing Consensus Inference and Pathway Probability sections.

recommendations.title: Single-group failure mode is documented incorrectly
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md states a single groupby category 'yields only autocrine self-edges, not intercellular signaling.' Empirically, li.mt.rank_aggregate on a constant-value groupby column raises `ValueError: Cannot compute log2FC for group '...': every cell belongs to it...` instead of returning autocrine edges.
recommendations.root_cause: The sentence describes an intuitive but unverified assumption about the failure mode rather than the tool's actual behavior.
recommendations.fix: Correct the sentence to: 'CCC needs >=2 cell types in `groupby`; a single group raises a ValueError (log2FC has no comparison group), not a silent autocrine-only result.'
